title: 2026-10-22_KAITEN_Botnet_Investigation_b7b
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents in a network compromised by the KAITEN botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized network connections. The suspicious service is likely named 'bot-beacon.service'. The final flag is bot-beacon.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to network communication or external connections.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl status' followed by the service name to check its status and network activity.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Network Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating the abnormal network traffic?
levels.solution: Examine the systemd services and look for any unusual or high-frequency network activity. The service generating abnormal network traffic is likely named 'bot-flood.service'. The final flag is bot-flood.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd services and look for any unusual or high-frequency network activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are scheduled to run frequently or have high network usage.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl status' followed by the service name to check its status and network activity.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the name of the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate the systemd timers and services to find how the suspicious service is scheduled to run periodically. The persistence mechanism is likely a systemd timer named 'bot-beacon.timer'. The final flag is bot-beacon.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd timers and services to find how the suspicious service is scheduled to run periodically.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for timers that trigger the suspicious service.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: Use the command 'systemctl status' followed by the timer name to check its status and triggers.
